Aggregate a monthly chart table to quarters

aggregate_to_quarters.Rd

Collapses a monthly wide table to quarters. Not a formula helper: it changes the row count, so it must run on the whole table at fetch time rather than in a formula cell. Chart-level by nature, since one period column means every series shares a frequency.

Usage

aggregate_to_quarters(
  data,
  value_cols,
  period_col = "period_id",
  aggr_func = mean,
  min_obs = 3L
)

Arguments

data

wide table with a period column and one column per series

value_cols

columns to aggregate

period_col

name of the period column, monthly (YYYYMnn)

aggr_func

aggregation function, e.g. mean or sum

min_obs

months required before a quarter is reported; 3 (the default) allows only complete quarters

Value

the table with one row per quarter, period column in YYYYQn form

Details

A quarter with fewer than min_obs observations comes back NA rather than as a partial aggregate — most important with sum, where two months of a three-month quarter reads as a collapse rather than as missing data. The resulting NA quarters are trimmed by chart_args_from_spec if no plotted series has data there.
